authorization: Human Documents Pro mission section2B requests minimized title/type/size/date/context; explicit reply delegates only backend proposal f1d452b with independent W4 review. No raw filename authorization is inferred.
row_policy: Same active workspace/membership and owner/admin metadata scope as document.v1; canonical target/ancestor joins all require same workspace. Target statuses do not silently change v1 metadata authority. Every page re-evaluates current rows before search/count/pagination.

fields.display_title: Generated solely from approved document category and first8 characters of the already returned document UUID; never original filename.
fields.created_at: Operational incorporation timestamp explicitly requested by owner; UTC with microsecond precision retained for correct stable keyset validation.
fields.customer_label: Same coalesce(trim(trade_name),legal_name) provenance as existing ordinary customer collection DTO, same authorized workspace; current value re-read each call.
fields.target_label: Generated entity category and short already-authorized target UUID; no phone/SIM/tax/private-note or protected commercial identifier.
fields.media_type_size: Existing document.v1 metadata fields; does not imply supported byte handling for arbitrary MIME. Filter groups limited to existing PDF/PNG/JPEG contracts.

search.transport: Bounded POST body only; never raw query/title/cursor in URL, analytics or logs.

cursor.opaque: PGP symmetric AES256 encryption with integrity protection; base64url bounded4096; key is random32bytes generated inside a private database table, never a literal secret in source/migration.
cursor.authority_binding: auth.uid, workspace, current membership ID/role/updated_at/xmin, workspace updated_at/xmin, key generation, canonical filter hash and sort/limit.
cursor.expiration: 10minutes maximum from initial creation cutoff, preserved across pages.
cursor.rotation: Privileged replacement of private key plus generation increment invalidates all old cursors; no public key-export or rotation endpoint.
cursor.drift: live_reauthorized_creation_cutoff. Creation cutoff bounds later normal inserts, but never promises a repeatable snapshot. Labels/status/relationships are current, and exact count can change between calls. Count and page are evaluated in one statement over the same authorized filter set.

gates.http: PRODUCT_DOCUMENT_LIBRARY_ENABLED must be explicitly true; defaultOFF.
gates.database: Private settings.enabled defaultsfalse; direct authenticated RPC cannot bypass it. Only disposable fixtures enable it for tests.
gates.storage: No policy/grant/object changes, no179/Storage88 adoption, no new bytes/preview enablement.
gates.folders: D2 NOT delegated; no folder schema or localStorage substitute.
gates.acceptance: Independent W4 policy/SQL/registry review and actual disposable Auth/browser evidence still required.
